items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You recorded with Clarence Williams Blue Five too (inaudible). [INTERVIEWEE] "Cakewalking Babies", what was that -- Jack Palmer's song.

ctx.x: Wasn't it Louie and Sidney Bechet and Clarence Williams?
Clarence Williams, Sidney Bechet, and Louis Armstrong. And who was on guitar? Wasn't somebody on guitar with me?
I don't remember. I have all that information.
